title: Surreal Time Collage
description: A composite digital artwork divided into distinct sections. The top half features a large pink clock with Roman numerals, a translucent young woman with crossed arms, and an elderly bearded man in a hat with a bird on his shoulder. The bottom half shows a lone figure in a boat on reflective water, a glowing ornate building with purple and yellow light, and a large neon green smiley face orb with swirling particles.
prompt: A surreal composite artwork split horizontally. Top section shows a large translucent pink clock with Roman numerals floating in a cloudy sky, a young woman with bare shoulders and crossed arms fading into the center, and a detailed monochrome portrait of an old bearded man wearing a hat with a crow on his shoulder. Bottom section displays a lone rower in a wooden boat on calm reflective water with mountains and a yellow moon behind, an ornate glowing building with purple and yellow light in the center, and a large glowing green smiley face orb with energy rings on the right. Dreamlike collage style, blended transitions, atmospheric lighting.
